title: 光强分级扫描：连续电流保留强度变化
short_title: Bi | 50 mm | pitch 2 mm | X 5 mm/s
anchor_method: broad far-edge current plateaus, not measured motion events; reviewed/extrapolated tail anchors
interpretation_notes: 行窗口由远端宽电流平台估计；平台中心不等于实测到位时刻。每对扫描行内暂按等采样速度映射。
秒表仅作平均行时长约束，不将积分设置0.1作为采样间隔。
末端缺乏对比度的窗口含外推；不校正光斑、探测器迟滞或机械窜动。
用户确认开始计时标记有误差，结束读数可能含额外等待；平均行时长及停留比例均为近似。
timing_evidence_status: user confirmed start mark approximately indicates motion start; end may include extra waiting
anchor_review_notes: last anchor extrapolated from previous three intervals; final plateau lacks a unique maximum
light_protocol: start at first hollow-region row, change every four rows; tape-covered top/bottom keep a fixed setting, per operator
operator_observation: no pause while present; occasional brief absence; no motion event log
